statement.zh: “生态崩溃”叙事与更审慎土地利用模型并存，不宜写成定论。
statement.en: An “ecological collapse” narrative coexists with more cautious land-use models and should not be written as settled fact.

disclaimer: Competing ecological histories; collapse is not a single established fact.
